title: Monsters of the Sunscar
changes: The desert is no longer empty: Dustrider raiders and their archers, Dune Scorpions, the Sand-Dead of Kharsun, Camel-Men of the mesas and the Veiled Circle's adepts, from Lv 30 by the waygate up to Lv 47 near the Thornspire.
Scorpions rush you and poison you, Camel-Men stamp the ground, Veiled Adepts throw sun-fire from afar. The Sand-Dead rise mostly at night.
Kel Ashar and the Sunstone Circle stay safe, and bounty boards only send you on hunts in the land you are in.
